_note: Graha descriptions and clock-ring legend colours used by the phone apps.

graha.science: A G2 star 1 AU away; its path against the stars is the ecliptic.
graha.lore: Soul and sovereignty; lord of Ravivāra and of Siṃha.

graha.science: Earth's satellite, 384,400 km away; laps the zodiac in 27.3 days.
graha.lore: Mind and emotion; lord of Somavāra and of Karkaṭa.

graha.science: Innermost planet; never strays more than 28° from the Sun.
graha.lore: Intellect and speech; lord of Budhavāra, Mithuna and Kanyā.

graha.science: Brightest planet, wrapped in sulphuric cloud; within 47° of the Sun.
graha.lore: Beauty, art and pleasure; lord of Śukravāra, Vṛṣabha and Tulā.

graha.science: The red planet; its retrograde loops puzzled every early astronomer.
graha.lore: Courage and conflict; lord of Maṅgalavāra, Meṣa and Vṛścika.

graha.science: The giant; spends about a year in each rāśi, which names the 60-year cycle.
graha.lore: Wisdom and the teacher of the gods; lord of Guruvāra, Dhanus and Mīna.

graha.science: Ringed and slow: 29.5 years round the zodiac, about 2½ years per rāśi.
graha.lore: Time, discipline and karma; lord of Śanivāra, Makara and Kumbha.

graha.science: Where the Moon's orbit crosses the ecliptic going north; eclipses happen near the nodes.
graha.lore: The shadow graha said to swallow the Sun and Moon at eclipses.

graha.science: Always opposite Rāhu; the nodes drift backwards once round in 18.6 years.
graha.lore: The headless body of the demon; detachment and liberation.

graha.science: The observer's home: every limb is measured from here.
graha.lore: Bhūmi Devī, the goddess who bears all.

rings.english: Hour dial — 60 per day from sunrise
Lunar mansions — Moon among the stars
Lunar day — Moon's lead on the Sun
